title: Gram identity for the linear graph map ι + ι'∘T (area Jacobian of a graph)
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝᵏ, and let T : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ be linear. Then (ι + ι'∘T)*∘(ι + ι'∘T) = id_{ℝⁿ} + T*∘T, where * is the adjoint (LinearMap.adjoint).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (T : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid k), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → LinearMap.adjoint (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ T) ∘ₗ (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ T) = LinearMap.id + LinearMap.adjoint T ∘ₗ T
